name: Plank
cues: Set your elbows under your shoulders
Squeeze your glutes and tuck your pelvis slightly
Keep your ears, hips and ankles in one line
Push the floor away so your upper back stays full

The mat is sized to the body so the feet and fists sit on it. Straight line and a breathing hold. Rated minor only because the primary (rectus abdominis) faces the floor, so the highlight reads mainly at the flank from the low side view.
